verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party bulk-operation feature, such as bulk-editing many issues or PRs, batch-applying labels or states, or a multi-select action. The REST and GraphQL APIs, GitHub CLI, MCP server and Actions are developer building blocks that could be scripted into bulk operations, which earns no credit under the partial-credit rules. The security campaigns and org-wide secret remediation snippets never describe acting on many items at once.
